title: Potable Water Assessment and Decision Support
objective: Translate integrated model outputs into actionable potable-water assessments and decisions.
questions: How can quantity and quality be integrated into defensible safe-water decision metrics?
How should treatment and intervention priorities be ranked under uncertainty?

specialSections.title: Quantity Assessment
specialSections.body: Estimate available groundwater volume under dynamic stress and scenario constraints.

specialSections.title: Water-Quality Standards
specialSections.body: Evaluate outputs against potable-water compliance thresholds and guideline limits.

specialSections.title: Potable-Volume Calculation
specialSections.body: Compute safe water volume after quantity, quality, and treatability constraints.

specialSections.title: Treatment Needs
specialSections.body: Assess treatment requirements from contaminant profiles and risk levels.

specialSections.title: Water-Safety Index
specialSections.body: Generate composite potable-water safety indicators for prioritization workflows.

specialSections.title: Uncertainty
specialSections.body: Communicate confidence bounds and uncertainty pathways for transparent decisions.

specialSections.title: Dashboards
specialSections.body: Expose actionable outputs through technical and stakeholder-ready dashboard views.

specialSections.title: Policy Recommendations
specialSections.body: Translate technical findings into implementable policy and utility action pathways.

tasks.title: Integrated Risk Synthesis
tasks.summary: Combine quantity and quality outputs from WP1-WP5 into risk-ready indicators.

tasks.title: Decision Engine and Dashboard
tasks.summary: Implement decision-support workflows for stakeholder-facing planning.

tasks.title: Demonstration and Policy Translation
tasks.summary: Run demonstration cases and map model outputs to policy action pathways.
